about: Every state element of the flow-of-record netlist that rst_n does not put into a known state on its own, with the reason it may stay that way (issue #131; target-spec row 14 (a); spec/verification-plan.md section 8, 'Reset-coverage listing'). Graded by verification/reset_coverage.py: a non-reset element missing here fails, and an entry here that names no non-reset element fails too. Adding an entry is a claim, not a waiver: it must say why the element cannot reach a pin or control flow before it is written, and cite the evidence that shows it.

justifications.what: The RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x16_c2_bm_bist SRAM macro (DR 0005): its 256 x 16-bit array and its registered read port (A_DOUT, the core's instr_word). The macro has no reset pin, and the contents are undefined after power-up and after every deselect (the organizers' 2026-10-09 entrant update).
justifications.justification: Nothing the macro holds is decoded, or reaches a pin, before it has been written since power-up or checked. (1) Array, MODE low at rst_n release: the core fetches from the boot ROM (DR 0013 layer 2; rom_exit and serial_loaded both reset to 0, so fetch_rom = 1) and the program memory does not even read the macro for fetch (pm_fetch = 0). The only reads are the warm-start check's RCTL PM_DATA_HI data reads, and only a WCTL RUN after that check passed (a nonzero word 255 and PM_CRC = 0 over all 256 words) switches the fetch source. (2) Array, MODE high at rst_n release: the serial load writes word k on the edge that completes its 16th bit (protocol_program_memory.v), and the core holds pc = 0 and executes nothing until run_phase rises on the MODE-drop edge, so every word of the loaded image is written before the core can fetch it. (3) A_DOUT register: at run entry the core spends one priming cycle with fetch_valid = 0 (DR 0005), so the stale word on A_DOUT is never executed; with the ROM as the source it is ignored except as RCTL PM_DATA_HI data in the stall cycle after the read that filled it. Residual, stated rather than hidden: after a serial load of N < 256 words, words N..255 keep their power-up contents and a loaded program that jumps or falls into them executes them -- a property of the host-loaded program (DR 0001 layer 1), not of reset; and DR 0013's all-zero image is its own valid CRC, which the warm start refuses for its zero signature since issue #168 (test_boot_rom.py::test_warm_start_refuses_a_zero_signature).
justifications.evidence: verification/test_reset_power_up.py (gate level: random and X array contents, MODE low, every strap: no macro fetch read, fetch source never leaves the ROM, the PC ends in the stub DR 0013's strap table names) and verification/test_boot_rom.py (warm start rejects corrupted images; RTL white-box pm_fetch / A_REN checks).
